figures.finding: Estonia's state sets a minimum monthly salary for culture workers with higher education, which covers actors employed by the culture ministry's institutions: EUR 1,720 a month from 2026 (up 7.5% from EUR 1,600), kept at EUR 1,720 for 2027.

value.name: kõrgharidusega kultuuritöötaja riiklik palga alammäär (state minimum salary of a culture worker with higher education)
value.setBy: Ministry of Culture through the state budget

figures.applies: Estonia, culture workers with higher education in institutions funded through the Ministry of Culture (including state theatres), 2026 and 2027.

sources.said: Ta rääkis, et kõrgharidusega kultuuritöötajate riiklik palga alammäär jääb 2027. aastal 1720 euro juurde, kuhu see tõusis tänavu. Tõusu suurus oli siis 7,5 protsenti.
Lisaraha võimaldab tõsta kõrgharidusega kultuuritöötaja riiklikku miinimumtasu 1600 eurolt 1720 eurole.

figures.finding: The Estonian Film Institute's production support exists to preserve and develop the Estonian language and cinema made by Estonian creators.
figures.applies: Estonia, films supported by the Estonian Film Institute.

sources.said: The Production department manages the support for film projects from start to finish: from idea to development, from production to premiere. … All for one great goal: to preserve and develop the Estonian language and the art of cinema made by Estonian creators.

figures.finding: The Estonian Actors' Union sets its members' minimum fees (adopted by its general meeting of 5 December 2022), below which no work offered to a member may be paid: in film, from 2023, €300 a shooting day of up to 10 hours and €150 a rehearsal day; in private television, for 2023, €234.33 a working day of up to 10 hours for a lead and €194.25 for a supporting part; at ERR, the public broadcaster, for 2023, €183.92 and €152.46. All gross; no later table is published.

figures.finding: The actors' union is Eesti Näitlejate Liit: its board admits actors on a personal application (CV, photo, reasoned letter), as a rule graduates of the drama schools of the Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre or the University of Tartu Viljandi Culture Academy; dues from 1 January 2026 are €6 a month for a freelance actor and 0.5% of pay, at most €9 a month, for a theatre employee.
